rows.text:
Do you think you could help me get my Sweetwater Saspiralla shipment back?
The delivery man got scared and lost several barrels somewhere in Thistlerow.
Wear the Student Chef Hat in your Chef equipment screen.
Put out the third farm fire
Choose Blacksmith in the Jobs menu.

Looks like Peep and I are missing some sheep and they are due for a good shearing.
They probably haven't wandered too far off. Think you could find and shear them for me?
Switch to Miner
Gather Rainleaf bundles at the farm while playing as Chef.

I know you already defeated some racers here, but I need to make sure you can dominate the field.
Take first place in enough races here to prove to me that you're the racer I should back.
Use the filled bucket on this fire. Follow the objectives in order.
Put out the second farm fire

I am the mighty Mekaletaliki! Do you take the Mighty Mekaletaliki Question Challenge?
Find my brother and speak to him.

That chocolate bread was horrible! Maybe you can help me find a different snack that I may like.
I hear that a robgoblin chef named Glerga makes something called a Booger Bar. Go get me one.
Read mail

First things first, you'll need to pass your driver's test.
After all, we can't have an inexperienced driver in the arena. It's just too dangerous!

You can talk to a few of the pros around the track to get tips on how to be a better demolition derby driver.
Destroy the second Gloam artifact
Approach this Gloam artifact and interact with it. Follow the objectives in order.
Choose Medic in the Jobs menu.
Equip the Student Chef Shirt
Switch to Chef

Now that I have all these kittens I do not know what to feed them Please speak to Cook Yumtumlot, she will know what to feed them. Cook Yumtumlot will be in her tent in the Thoroughfare in Wugachug. Then look for the food she recommends and bring it back to me.

I made it all up! You just stole Chase Wheeler's high end parts for me! Hahaha!
The only way you can make this right and win back his parts is to beat me in a race! if you do, I'll give you his parts back so you can go try and make amends!

Wow, you made it to round three! Are you ready?
Remember this order now... Good luck!

Tag Roberto, Ruberto, Ruberto, Ted, Roberto, Ribberto, Ted, Ruberto, Ted, and finally, Ribberto!
Put out the first farm fire
Gather Gummyfruit bundles at the farm while playing as Chef.

Sorry, [*player*]. If I wasn't such a klutz, I'd have some candy to give you.
I tripped on my way back from the barracks, and all the candy I was carrying fell into the water!

If you get it back for me, I'd be happy to give you some.
Harvest Gummyfruit

Welcome to Sandstorm Speedway! Well, as you can tell, this place is new and not quite hoppin' with excitement yet.
I bet people that signed up for Email Blasts know of some good people to bring over.

Will you help me find them?
Destroy the first Gloam artifact

I saw a bunch of cats lugging around fish. All the cats in town are owned by someone, right?
Can you check all the cats' bowls to see if one of the cats took Flax's fish? Remember, his fish wore collars.

People are going coco-nuts for my latest chilly drink creation! Will you help me keep up with the orders?
Just grab some drinks from the bucket and be sure to finish the delivery before they melt!

My little kitten Gertrude is lost! I cannot find her on my own, I have looked everywhere! My shift is about to start at the Sarsaparilla Brewery and I can not go to work without knowing she is ok. Please find Gertrude! She always liked to visit Cook Yumtumlot down at the cook tent. Perhaps she is down there now! Will you please go look for her?
Harvest Rainleaf

Ok, you and I are going to race. If you beat Sparks, you can't be too bad. As they say, any publicity is good publicity right?
A quick word of advice - try to stay positive after you loose. It will help your image.

Ready to mix it up?

I came here looking for some royal honey, the sweetest and tastiest of the bixie honey, but it seems that there's been some sort of an uprising.
I heard a bixie soldier named Fauzz was keeping the honey safe, but it sounds as if he's part of this rebellion!

Would you be willing to go into the Bixie Hive and hunt some down for me?

Things haven't been going so well lately in the Glade. First the lights started acting up, and now Edvard the gardener has been having trouble with his plants.
You'd think we'd have enough life magic here to keep the flowers in bloom!

Would you mind lending him a hand?
Wear the Student Chef Shirt in your Chef equipment screen.
Switch to Brawler

Have you seen Cutes today? She's got a really bad case of the hiccups! Poor girl... we have to help her!
Now, I'm no expert, but I believe that the only way to cute hiccups is to give the hiccup-er a real scare! I have just the thing too!

Find Cutes Dozen, and scare those hiccups right out of her!
Choose Chef in the Jobs menu.
Destroy the third Gloam artifact
Switch to Medic
Your next step is to tackle Tavil, who is leading the Shadown Talon Clan's operations in the Deep Mines. However, you need to be more experienced before I could send you on such a perilous task.

The Thunder Falls Crash for Coin is a highly sought after derby in which only the best drivers can participate.
The name says it all. The more cars you crash, the more coin you'll earn! You can see why it's so popular, right?

Show 'em what you're made of, [*player*]!

Listen, I know you're a great driver, but maybe we should rethink trying to take back the track.
This isn't the big screen, [*player*]. Those drivers in there are dangerous! Your fans would be devastated if something were to happen to you.

If you insist on being the hero, just be careful, okay?
Choose Miner in the Jobs menu.

Very wll then. I am not a man to back down when my skills are called into question!
This race will be boost heavy. It will be your skill behine the wheel against mine! With less trick gadgets like mines and missiles to get in the way, we shall see what we are truly made of!
Are you prepared to face me?
Switch to Blacksmith
Equip the Student Chef Hat

I suppose now that my ride's back in action you want to see if you can outrace me and increase your ranking. I'm game, but don't think it will be as easy as that for you.
Linx may have been using my parts when you raced him, but he doesn't have my instincts behind the wheel.

With all the farmhands we have around here, keeping them fed is hard work!
I still haven't even collected veggies for dinner tonight. Could you help me out?
Switch to Archer
Choose Brawler in the Jobs menu.
Choose Archer in the Jobs menu.

You look fabulous, [*player*]! I wish everything was as easy as casting you as our stunt double. Sadly, our movie set is still incomplete.
The director wants an exact replica of the Thunder Falls arena but our crew misplaced a bunch of our props. You'll be an angel and help out, right?
